name: enumerate_mem
statement: ∀ s a, sel s = some a → a ∈ s) : ∀ {s n a}, enumerate sel s n = some a → a ∈ s | s, 0, a => h_sel s a | s, n + 1, a => by cases h : sel s with | none => simp [enumerate_eq_none_of_sel, h] | some a' => simp only [enumerate, h] exact fun h' : enumerate sel (s \ {a'}) n = some a ↦ have : a ∈ s \ {a'}
